eligibility.req: Lead SME <200 employees (group total if consolidated) at lodgement
Australian-incorporated trading corporation, or incorporated trustee of trading trust
Partners: lead SME + second Australian industry entity + Australian research organisation (CRCs not research orgs)
Every partner contributes cash, cash-staff and/or in-kind
Grant <= 50% of total eligible project expenditure
Short-term industry-identified, industry-led collaborative research with >=1 eligible activity, benefits SMEs
Lead not an excluded entity type (GL 4.3 list)
No partner on Redress Scheme non-joined list
Applicant and partners not a 100+ employer non-compliant with the WGEA Act 2012
Each partner's authorised rep confirms 4 partner statements

merit.text: how your project will address an industry-identified problem, improve the competitiveness, productivity and sustainability of Australian industries and the extent of alignment with government priorities
how your project will foster high quality research through industry-led and outcome-focused collaborative industry-research partnerships
how your project will encourage and facilitate SME participation
the research you will do and the methodologies you will use, including describing the role of your partners in the project
how your research will address the identified problem, build on the current body of knowledge and enhance the adoption of new technologies
the education and training opportunities your project will provide to build capability and capacity in the industry and research sectors (e.g. number of students)
how you will manage and monitor your project, explaining the governance and planning arrangements, including security
how you will manage risks, including but not limited to security (in particular any associated national security issues), involvement of international partners and intellectual property protection
your access to required resources including naming personnel with the right skills and experience, funding, security, infrastructure, technology and intellectual property

how the grant will impact the project in terms of scale and timing, including justification for the funding amount requested and whether the project could proceed without Australian Government funding
the total investment the grant will leverage and why the Australian Government should invest in your project, including how grant benefits will be substantially retained in Australia
how your project will have a positive impact for communities and businesses in regional and remote Australia
the commercial potential of your project, including the expected commercial outputs such as new products, processes or services, any expected spill over benefits and plans at the end of the project

narrative_fields.name: Detailed project description and key activities
Partner's involvement: role, contributions, company structure and relationships (per partner, one response covering AF-F.4c)
